subject: Cloudflare renewal — counterproposal and contract mark-up
body:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@cloudflare.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@cloudflare.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal quote for Cloudflare Enterprise (WAF/CDN/Gateway)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the chat last week. Attached is the preliminary renewal package for Redwood Inference: a two-year term for our Enterprise bundle (API Gateway + CDN + Managed WAF). Key highlights from the quote (see attached spreadsheet):
- List price: $420k/year (2-year commit)
- Proposed commercial concession: 15% off list for a 2-year upfront commit
- Egress credit: 25% discount on egress above baseline
- Included: dedicated support SLA (4 hr P1), monthly WAF tuning sessions (1 hr)

Open items we flagged on our side:
- Termination language for data retention (customer data purge windows)
- Exact definition of traffic baselines for egress calculations
- Attachment: 20260601_cloudflare_quote_v1.xlsx

If you can review and let me know any internal constraints (SLA, egress sensitivity, approval path), I can scope a final term sheet. We can also add a clause to pilot WAF custom rule development if that helps justify the rate.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Account Executive, Cloudflare

----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal quote for Cloudflare Enterprise (WAF/CDN/Gateway)

Marcus / Laura — forwarding Cloudflare's initial renewal package (attached). High level: list price is ~$420k/year; they offered 15% off for a 2-year prepay and 25% egress credits above baseline. Their SLA is 4 hr P1 (managed support).

Questions / asks for you both:
- Marcus: technical constraints — are we ok with proposed baselines and the way egress will be measured? Any appetite to trade a longer commit for lower egress rates?
- Laura: commercial — do you want me to push for stronger credits or performance SLAs before we commit? CFO will want a 12–18 month runway; finance prefers annual invoicing if possible.

My suggested starting negotiation points (to pick from):
1) Push for 2-year term with 25% off list + 30% egress credit above baseline OR
2) Keep 1-year term, lower list price (20% off) and quarterly review OR
3) Accept their 2-year but add termination right on material performance regressions and a trial WAF tuning/cost assessment clause.

I'll assemble a counterproposal if you confirm preferred approach.

Thanks — Jordan
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal quote for Cloudflare Enterprise (WAF/CDN/Gateway)

Jordan — quick notes inline below.

Inline: 'List price: $420k/year' — confirm what that covers (requests, edge compute functions, WAF managed rules). We need a clear breakdown between CDN egress, per-request processing (API Gateway), and managed WAF rule labor.

Negotiation priorities from infra:
- Egress is the major cost swing for us. We should request either a higher baseline or a steeper egress discount after the baseline (aim for 40% discount beyond baseline for the first 12 months).
- SLA: 4 hr P1 is OK on first pass but we need credit triggers tied to tail latency for API Gateway (p99 latency > 200ms for 5 consecutive days should trigger credits).
- WAF tuning: include 6 months of weekly tuning sessions, then monthly thereafter, with deliverables (rule efficacy report).
- Termination: add a 90-day remediation then termination right for repeated SLA misses.

Commercial ask for finance (Laura): aim for annual invoicing with net-45 payment terms for a 2-year committed price — that keeps cashflow manageable. Also ask for a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration/testing (one month free).

If we get the above, accept the 2-year commit. Otherwise prefer 12-month with exit window after 9 months.

Marcus
VP, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference

----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@cloudflare.com>, Cloudflare Legal <legal@cloudflare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood counterproposal to Cloudflare renewal (attached mark-up)

Samantha — thanks for the initial package and for being flexible on a few items. After discussing with platform and finance, Redwood's counterproposal (attached) includes the following high-level points:

1) Commercial
- Two-year term, 15% off list in year 1, 10% off list in year 2 (blended ~12.5%) as an alternative to their first offer.
- Egress: define baseline using trailing 90-day average; 40% discount on egress above baseline for the first 12 months, 30% thereafter.
- Annual invoicing with net-45 payment terms; one-time onboarding credit equal to one month of service applied at contract start.

2) Service & SLAs
- Retain managed WAF and monthly tuning, but include 6-week onboarding with weekly tuning sessions and a deliverable report at the end of onboarding.
- Add p99 latency credit: if p99 API Gateway latency > 200ms for 5 out of 7 days, automatic 10% service credit for that month.
- P1 response remains 4 hours, but require a 24-hour remediation plan for incidents that impact traffic routing.

3) Termination & Data
- 90-day remediation window following SLA regressions with right to terminate if remediation fails twice in 12 months.
- Data retention: Cloudflare to purge customer-controlled logs within 30 days of request or provide a documented exception with justification.

Attached are: redwood_cf_counter_20260609.pdf (summary) and redwood_cf_marked_up_contract_20260609.docx (track changes on legal language).

If this looks reasonable on your side, can your legal team accept the marked changes or suggest edits? If so, please send a DocuSign link and we can route to finance (Laura) for signature.

Samantha — happy to hop on a 30-minute call Thurs morning if you want to walk through the redlines live.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
